label: Interest Income
definition: Revenue earned from interest on loans and other interest-bearing assets.
reason: Material revenue stream for lending business

label: Servicing Fees Income
definition: Revenue earned from servicing loans on behalf of third parties or investors.
reason: Material revenue stream for loan servicing operations

label: Loan Origination Fees
definition: Fees charged to borrowers for processing and originating new loans.
reason: Material revenue stream from loan origination activities

label: Career Karma Income
definition: Revenue generated from Career Karma platform operations and services.
reason: Distinct revenue stream from acquired platform

label: Other Revenues
definition: Miscellaneous revenue not classified in other primary revenue categories.
reason: Catch-all revenue category completing revenue breakdown

label: Sales and Marketing
definition: Expenses related to sales activities, marketing campaigns, and customer acquisition.
reason: Material operating expense category distinct from G&A

label: Depreciation and Amortisation
definition: Non-cash expense for depreciation of fixed assets and amortization of intangible assets.
reason: Material non-cash operating expense

label: FX Gain/Loss & Miscellaneous
definition: Foreign exchange gains or losses and other miscellaneous non-operating items.
reason: Non-operating income/expense item

label: Gain on Deferred Tuition
definition: Gains recognized from deferred tuition arrangements or related financial instruments.
reason: Non-operating gain specific to business model

label: Gain/(Loss) on Loan Sale
definition: Gains or losses realized from the sale of loan portfolios to third parties.
reason: Material non-operating item from loan portfolio sales

label: Restricted Cash
definition: Cash held in restricted accounts for specific purposes such as loan collateral or regulatory requirements.
reason: Material current asset for lending operations with regulatory requirements

label: Loans Receivable, Net (Current)
definition: Net carrying value of current portion of loans originated to customers, after allowances for credit losses.
reason: Material asset for lending business; distinct from trade receivables

label: Loans Receivable, Gross
definition: Gross amount of loans receivable before allowances and reserves.
reason: Component detail of net loans receivable

label: Allowance for Loan Losses
definition: Contra-asset reserve for expected credit losses on loans receivable.
reason: Critical reserve for lending operations

label: Interest Receivable, Net
definition: Accrued interest income earned but not yet collected on loans and investments, net of allowances.
reason: Material for interest-earning loan portfolio

label: Deferred Tuition Asset
definition: Prepaid tuition amounts paid to educational institutions on behalf of borrowers.
reason: Unique to education financing model; material operational asset

label: Prepaid Expenses
definition: Expenses paid in advance for future periods including marketing, rent, and services.
reason: Standard current asset category with multiple detail lines

label: Deferred Commission Asset, Current
definition: Capitalized sales commissions to be amortized over customer contract period (current portion).
reason: ASC 606 compliance asset for contract acquisition costs

label: Restricted Cash, Current
definition: Cash held in restricted accounts for specific purposes, available within one year.
reason: Common for lending operations with reserve requirements

label: Loans Receivable, Noncurrent
definition: Net carrying value of loans receivable due beyond one year.
reason: Long-term portion of loan portfolio

label: Expected Residual Values
definition: Estimated future value of assets or cash flows expected from loan portfolio at maturity.
reason: Specialized asset for loan servicing economics

label: Capitalized Software Development Costs
definition: Internally developed software costs capitalized and amortized over useful life.
reason: Standard intangible asset for tech-enabled companies

label: Content Intangible Assets
definition: Capitalized costs for educational or marketing content with future economic benefit.
reason: Relevant for education platform business model

label: Security Deposits
definition: Deposits paid for office leases and other long-term commitments.
reason: Standard noncurrent asset detail

label: Operating Lease Liability, Current
definition: Current portion of operating lease obligations due within one year.
reason: Material current liability component of total operating lease liability

label: Intangible Assets, Gross
definition: Gross value of intangible assets including organization costs and internal use software before accumulated amortization.
reason: Material intangible asset category combining organization costs and internal use software

label: Accumulated Amortization, Intangibles
definition: Cumulative amortization of intangible assets reducing gross intangible asset value.
reason: Material contra-asset reducing intangible assets on balance sheet

label: Deferred Commission Asset, Noncurrent
definition: Long-term portion of capitalized sales commissions to be amortized over customer relationship period.
reason: Material deferred cost asset for SaaS/lending business model

label: Accounts Payable, Current
definition: Trade payables due to vendors for goods and services received.
reason: Core component of accounts payable and accrued liabilities total

label: Accrued Expenses, Current
definition: Expenses incurred but not yet paid including accrued interest, taxes, and other operating expenses.
reason: Core component of accounts payable and accrued liabilities total

label: Accrued Compensation and Benefits, Current
definition: Accrued payroll, bonuses, commissions, PTO, and other employee compensation liabilities.
formula_expression: Regular Pay + Bonuses & Commission + PTO + Other Compensation
reason: Material employee-related liability component of accrued liabilities

label: Convertible Debt, Current
definition: Current portion of convertible debt instruments due within one year.
reason: Material current debt obligation distinct from standard term debt

label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
source_label: Current Portion of LT Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
definition: Current portion of long-term debt due within one year, net of unamortized debt issuance costs.
reason: Standard current liability for debt maturing within one year

label: Due to Affiliates, Current
definition: Amounts owed to related parties and affiliated entities due within one year.
reason: Material related party liability for company with affiliate relationships

label: Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
definition: Long-term deferred revenue from origination fees and other advance payments to be recognized beyond one year.
reason: Material long-term deferred revenue for lending business model

label: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
definition: Fair value of derivative instruments in liability position, typically related to convertible debt features.
reason: Material liability from embedded derivatives in convertible debt

label: Escheatment Liability
definition: Liability for unclaimed property that must be remitted to state authorities under escheatment laws.
reason: Material liability category specific to financial services; total line with year-specific components

label: Deferred Cost of Revenue
definition: Prepaid costs that will be recognized as cost of revenue in future periods when related revenue is recognized.
reason: Matches deferred revenue pattern; represents prepaid costs to be matched with future revenue

label: Security Deposit Liability, Noncurrent
definition: Long-term liability for security deposits received from customers or related to leased facilities.
reason: Specific noncurrent liability detail; common for companies with lease arrangements

label: Deferred Sublease Rental Income
definition: Deferred income from sublease arrangements to be recognized over the lease term.
reason: Deferred income related to sublease; indicates company subleases space

label: Accrued Interest Payable
definition: Interest expense incurred but not yet paid on outstanding debt obligations.
formula_expression: part of Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
reason: Common accrued liability component; company has significant debt per mapped concepts

label: Due from Related Parties
definition: Amounts receivable from related parties for operational transactions or advances.
reason: Related party receivable; material enough to appear as separate line item

label: Due to Related Parties
definition: Amounts payable to related parties for operational transactions or advances.
reason: Related party payable; counterpart to due from related parties

label: Change in Deferred Taxes
definition: Non-cash adjustment for changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities in operating cash flow.
formula_expression: part of Cash Flow from Operating Activities
reason: Standard operating cash flow reconciliation item; company has tax expense per mapped concepts

label: Change in Accounts Payable
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in accounts payable balances during the period.
reason: Standard operating cash flow working capital component

label: Change in Other Current Liabilities
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in other current liability balances during the period.
reason: Operating cash flow working capital component

label: Change in Tax Liability
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in income tax payable balances during the period.
reason: Operating cash flow working capital component for taxes

label: Change in Accounts Receivable
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in accounts receivable balances during the period.
reason: Standard operating cash flow working capital component

label: Change in Inventory
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in inventory balances during the period.
reason: Standard operating cash flow working capital component

label: Change in Work In Progress
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in work-in-progress inventory balances during the period.
reason: Operating cash flow working capital component for WIP inventory

label: Change in Other Current Assets
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in other current asset balances during the period.
reason: Operating cash flow working capital component

label: Capital Expenditures
source_label: Change in Fixed Assets (ex. Depn and Amort)
definition: Cash outflows for purchases of property, plant, and equipment.
reason: Standard investing cash flow component for PP&E purchases

label: Intangible Asset Purchases
definition: Cash outflows for purchases or development of intangible assets.
reason: Investing cash flow component for intangible asset acquisitions

label: Change in Investments and Other Non-Current Assets
source_label: Change in Investments or Other Non-Current Assets
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in long-term investments and other non-current assets.
reason: Investing cash flow component for non-current asset changes

label: Dividends Paid
definition: Cash outflows for dividend payments to shareholders.
reason: Standard financing cash flow component for dividend distributions

label: Change in Short-Term Debt
definition: Cash flow impact from net borrowings or repayments of short-term debt.
reason: Standard financing cash flow component for short-term debt changes

label: Change in Long-Term Debt
definition: Cash flow impact from net borrowings or repayments of long-term debt.
reason: Standard financing cash flow component for long-term debt changes

label: Change in Other Non-Current Liabilities
definition: Cash flow impact from changes in other long-term liability balances during the period.
reason: Financing cash flow component for other non-current liability changes
